purpose: Test whether chronological quarterly refitting reduces probability staleness/calibration error seen in r2 without tuning betting thresholds to observed ROI.

inherits.reason: Only r2 families with market logloss improvement are eligible; fundamental is excluded because it materially underperformed market calibration.

chronology.rule: Every prediction must be generated by a model fitted only on records strictly earlier than the evaluation quarter. No future-quarter labels, outcomes or features may enter fit/calibration.

missing_data_policy: A quarter lacking required historical feature sidecars is INCOMPLETE, not zero-purchase/SKIP, and cannot contribute to an annual pass.
selection_policy: Do not grid-search minEV, odds caps, point counts or budget. Compare only the preregistered chronological refit against the frozen r2 counterpart on calibration/logloss first; profitability is evaluated only with the inherited fixed betting policy.

holdout.rule: Do not read or evaluate until a complete candidate including model family, capacity, refit cadence, feature set and betting policy is frozen from pre-holdout evidence.

promotion: No automatic production promotion. Android integration requires separate normal-chat review after all gates pass.
